Find samples by run accession

Source: R/metadata.R
cmgd_find_runs.Rd

Looks up SRA/ENA run accessions (SRR..., ERR..., DRR...) in the release's samples table, where a sample's runs are ;-joined in run_accessions.

Usage

cmgd_find_runs(rel, run, cache = cmgd_cache_dir())

Arguments

rel

A release from cmgd_release().

run

Run accessions.

cache

Cache directory.

Value

A data.frame with one row per run, in order: run, then the matching samples row (study_name, sample_key, ...); all NA for a run not in the release. Errors with class cmgdr_no_metadata if the release has no samples table.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("duckdb", quietly = TRUE)) {
    rel <- cmgd_release("cmgd_mpa4.2-2.3.0", release = "2026-10-16")
    cmgd_find_runs(rel, c("ERR478962", "ERR1474586"), cache = tempdir())
}

#> 1  ERR478962   ZellerG_2014 RS.8G5cd1ZeZW4RVHDQitQ1t5PV7IHCue2p
#> 2 ERR1474586 LassalleF_2017 RS.03kxtlz2sN5chfT1RCwEeJcKuVWWwe-E
